description: The client contract of plan-marshall-mcp (pm-api) and everything that runs outside the pm-mcpd daemon: the job launcher pm-exec, the host-facing relay pm-mcp (pm-relay), the operator CLI/TUI pm-operator, the scenario-driven mock runtime and the SvelteKit operator web app with its Playwright E2E suite.
description_reasoning: README.md module table and CLAUDE.md Project section

documentation.description: Repository-local documentation: the design of the two clients and what they share (doc/design, the specification their implementation follows), the work-package plans (doc/plans) and the review records.

guard-control-central-before-registry.description: Fixture project for BuildGuardsIT of pm-api that deliberately violates one build guard of the root POM (central-before-registry) and must fail the build; it is not a module of the reactor.

guard-control-jackson-databind.description: Fixture project for BuildGuardsIT of pm-api that deliberately violates one build guard of the root POM (jackson-databind) and must fail the build; it is not a module of the reactor.

guard-control-model-facing-content.description: Fixture project for BuildGuardsIT of pm-api that deliberately violates one build guard of the root POM (model-facing-content) and must fail the build; it is not a module of the reactor.

guard-control-product-module.description: Fixture project for BuildGuardsIT of pm-api that deliberately violates one build guard of the root POM (product-module) and must fail the build; it is not a module of the reactor.

pm-api.description: Client contract of the daemon API shared by pm-mcp and pm-operator: machine paths, the Unix-socket HTTP/SSE client, the on-demand daemon start, runtime-token checks, host detection and the data contracts of every API surface, built on the jackson-core streaming API only.

pm-exec.description: Tiny native job launcher pm-exec that the runtime starts every job through, creating the job's process group and confinement; depends on no other module of the product.

pm-mcp-clients.description: Aggregator and root POM of the client build: lists the modules, inherits Java release, managed versions and the deployment target from de.planmarshall:pm-mcp-parent, and carries the enforcer executions that guard the dependency rules.

pm-mock-runtime.description: Scenario-driven in-memory mock of the daemon serving the Unix-domain socket and loopback HTTP API, used for manual testing of the clients and as the stub daemon behind CLI tests via its JUnit 5 extension.

pm-operator.description: Operator CLI pm-operator (native binary): status, runtime start/stop and web enable/disable commands plus the full-screen JLine terminal client with plan, epic, overview and report views, built on pm-api and picocli only.

pm-relay.description: Host- and model-facing CLI pm-mcp (native binary): the serve STDIO relay that connects harness sessions and workers to the daemon, built on pm-api and picocli only.

pm-web-app-maven.description: Maven side of the operator web app: packages the built SvelteKit SPA as a resource JAR so the runtime can serve it.

pm-web-app-npm.description: Browser-based operator web interface (SvelteKit 3 + Svelte 5 + Vite) talking to the daemon's loopback HTTP API: views for plans, decisions, reports, devices and pairing, with Vitest unit tests.

pm-web-e2e-maven.description: Maven wrapper that runs the Playwright end-to-end suite of the web app inside the build against the mock runtime.

pm-web-e2e-npm.description: End-to-end Playwright tests of pm-web-app, driving a real browser against the app served with the mock runtime.

name: pm-mcp-clients
